posteriores.texto: Pela manhã, Jônatas saiu ao campo, no horário combinado com Davi, acompanhado de um rapaz ainda jovem.
Jônatas disse ao rapaz: “Corra e procure as flechas que vou atirar.” O rapaz correu, e Jônatas atirou uma flecha para além dele.

kjv.texto: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

vizinhos.33: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
vizinhos.35: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
